package.name: px4_control
package.description: Companion-computer controller node for PX4 SITL: subscribes to vehicle odometry/status/battery and drives the quad via VehicleThrustSetpoint + VehicleTorqueSetpoint using a geometric-PD controller. Forwards takeoff/land/disarm as VehicleCommand. Exposes a /tui/state and /tui/cmd interface for a separate TUI.
